'''Ziss't''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who worked as a laborer and lived in the [[Gnawer's Roost]] district of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He was visiting the [[Invisible Hand cantina]] along with his friend, [[Q'elliss]], when it became the site of a firefight between the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agent [[Tavik Moern]] and some [[Quarren/Legends|Quarrens]] against the [[Alderaanian Resistance]]. He and his friend ducked and attempted to flee the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] at the first opportunity available.
